BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                  OF THE STATE OF MISSOURI

In the Matter of Union Electric Company      )
d/b/a Ameren Missouri’s Tariff to Adjust its ) Case No. ER-2026-0291
Revenues for Electric service                )

APPLICATION TO INTERVENE OF WARRENTON DC OWNER 1 LLC
            AND WARRENTON DC OWNER 2 LLC

      Warrenton DC Owner 1 LLC and Warrenton DC Owner 2 LLC (jointly,
"Warrenton DC Owners"), pursuant to 20 CSR 4240-2.075 of the Missouri
Public Service Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure and for their
Application to Intervene, respectfully state as follows:
      1.    Warrenton DC Owners plan to site a new hyperscale enterprise
data center near Warrenton, Missouri. That facility will be served by Ameren
Missouri.
      2.    On June 26, 2026, Union Electric Company d/b/a Ameren Missouri
submitted tariff sheets to produce a net increase in its electric base rates of
approximately $343 million.
      3.    On June 30, 2026, the Commission issued its Order Giving Notice,
setting a deadline to intervene, setting a deadline to respond to the test year,
and directing a proposed schedule.
      4.    Warrenton     DC    Owners    seek   to   intervene   because    the
Commission's actions herein could affect Warrenton DC Owners' interests.
      5.    Warrenton DC Owners will be among Ameren's largest customers,
such that they have an interest in this proceeding different from that of the
general public. Warrenton DC Owners' interest will not and cannot be
adequately represented by any other party.
      6.    Warrenton DC Owners do not yet have a position on the issues in
this case and reserve the right to take positions on specific issues as this case
 after review of discovery and additional information to be adduced during the
pendency of the proceeding.
        7.   Warrenton DC Owners' intervention will serve the public interest
by assisting the development of the record for the Commission's decision in this
case.
        8.   Correspondence or communications regarding this application,
including service of all notices and orders of this Commission, should be
addressed to:
        Stephanie S. Bell
        Ellinger Bell LLC
        308 East High Street, Suite 300
        Jefferson City, MO 65101
        (573) 750-4100
        sbell@ellingerlaw.com

        WHEREFORE, Warrenton DC Owners respectfully request that the
Commission issue an order granting their Application to Intervene and that
they be made parties hereto with all rights to participate in this case.

                                     Respectfully submitted,

                               By:   /s/ Stephanie S. Bell
                                     Stephanie S. Bell, #61855
                                     ELLINGER BELL LLC
                                     308 East High Street, Suite 300
                                     Jefferson City, MO 65101
                                     Telephone: (573) 750-4100
                                     Facsimile: (314) 334-0450
                                     E-mail: sbell@ellingerlaw.com

                                     Attorneys for Warrenton DC Owner 1 LLC
                                     and Warrenton DC Owner 2 LLC
                        CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

      I hereby certify that a true and correct copy of the foregoing was served
upon all of the parties of record or their counsel, pursuant to the Service List
maintained by the Data Center of the Missouri Public Service Commission on
July 15, 2026.

                                                 /s/ Stephanie S. Bell
